content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR IARI Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR IARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 07 September 2026. Candidates are advised to report at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Young Professional post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Young Professional posts in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional-I (YP-I) Admin post?
faq.answer: For the YP-I Admin post, candidates need a Graduation degree in Computer Applications, Information Technology, Computer Science, B.Sc. (IT), BCA, B.A. with Computer Applications, BA, B.Sc., or B.Com with Computer as a subject.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Young Professional posts is 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-II (YP-II) PME Cell post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Young Professional-II (YP-II) PME Cell post is Rs. 42,000/- per month (fixed).

faq.question: Q7. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the Indian Agricultural Research Institute (ICAR IARI) located in Gogamukh, Assam, with the pincode 787035.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an age relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST candidates and 3 years for OBC candidates.
